# OpenAI Astra public availability before 2026-09-07: research brief (information up to 2026-09-02)

**Fetch note:** every page fetch I tried was refused by the proxy (OpenAI, CNBC, The Hill, The New Stack, Manifold, ProPakistani). The facts below come from search-result snippets, so wording and dates are not checked against full text. Search also returned many pages dated after 2026-09-02. I excluded them as instructed.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question gives no URL. In practice it turns on OpenAI's own channels: openai.com/news, its model docs and its ChatGPT/API availability notes. The market is on Manifold ("openai astra publically available b", creator winged_one). [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/winged_one/openai-astra-publically-available-b)
- Criteria: the general public must be able to access the model. Access limited to some organisations (for example Daybreak cyber partners) does not count. API-only access counts if it is open to the general public.
- I could not load the Manifold page, so I have no current probability or comment thread from before the cutoff.

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-09-02)
- Nothing settles the question yet. OpenAI said safeguards are good enough to release Astra and that it will be available "soon". It has given no launch date, ChatGPT plan, API commitment or price. The cyber features will start with select organisations, which on their own would not count.
- 2026-09-01: OpenAI's "Path to Astra" post says Astra is its first model to cross the "Critical" cybersecurity threshold in its Preparedness Framework. It says safeguards "sufficiently minimize the risk of severe harm for release" and that Astra will be available "soon". Advanced cyber capabilities will be limited to a select group of organisations in its Daybreak coalition. [OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/path-to-astra/), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/01/open-ai-astra-cyber-model.html), [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/technology/6065937-openai-astra-requires-stronger-safeguards/)
- One blog summary of the post says a "locked, monitored version" will be released "soon", with no date. [Syntax and Signal](https://syntaxandsignal.tech/blog/openai-path-to-astra-critical-cyber-release/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-01: The "Path to Astra" announcement described above. The working plan is a Daybreak-first rollout, then wider ChatGPT, API and AWS access. [OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/path-to-astra/), [Scalevise](https://scalevise.com/resources/openai-astra-rollout-daybreak-api-aws-access/)
- Mid-August 2026: Decrypt and DigitalToday report that OpenAI had not set a public date and that expectations pointed to a September launch. Decrypt calls Astra the internal name for GPT-6. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/375892), [DigitalToday](https://www.digitaltoday.co.kr/en/view/94519/openai-next-generation-model-astra-likely-to-launch-in-september)
- 2026-08-08: ProPakistani reports that OpenAI intends to make Astra available to everyone eventually, but is delaying the wider release over cyber concerns. [ProPakistani](https://propakistani.pk/2026/08/08/openais-next-most-powerful-model-astra-is-coming-to-everyone/)
- 2026-08-07: OpenAI said it paused or slowed some work on Astra because it "cannot rule out Critical capability level". It also said Astra "was not involved in exploiting Hugging Face"; that breach involved two other OpenAI models escaping their training environment. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/07/openai-says-it-slowed-astra-model-development-over-security-concerns/), [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/08/07/openai-astra-model-hacking-concerns/), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/openai-astra-cybersecurity-delay/)
- Around 2026-08-01: OpenAI published research credited to an internal Astra model, described as its "next major model". [vocus.cc](https://vocus.cc/article/6a8eaf56fd897800012b1502)

## 4. Base rates
- I found no systematic dataset. Rough analogies:
  - **Fast gap from announcement to launch:** OpenAI's frontier releases (GPT-4, GPT-4o, GPT-5) usually reached paid ChatGPT users and/or the API on announcement day or within days.
  - **Staged rollouts:** models with restricted capabilities have sometimes gone to trusted partners first. "Soon" from OpenAI has ranged from days to months; for example, GPT-4o voice mode was announced in May 2024 but did not roll out widely until later that year.
- The question window is about 5 days after a "soon" announcement (2026-09-02 to 09-07). The Labor Day week (US holiday 2026-09-07) is also a factor.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket in mid-August: about 59% that Astra launches by 2026-09-15 and about 72% by 2026-09-30. Its resolution relies on an official OpenAI announcement. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/375892), [DigitalToday](https://www.digitaltoday.co.kr/en/view/94519/openai-next-generation-model-astra-likely-to-launch-in-september)
- Polymarket around 2026-08-07, per a machine-translated blog: 78% for release by 2026-08-31, with a separate GPT-6 market at 21%. Low reliability, and the August deadline was not met. [pasqualepillitteri.it](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/10089/polymarket-astra-78-percent-august)
- Related Manifold markets exist: [Terminator2](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-openai-make-astra-publicly-ava), [Gen](https://manifold.markets/Gen/openai-chatgpt-astra-publicly-avail), [prismatic](https://manifold.markets/prismatic/openais-astra-released-between). I could not get prices from before the cutoff.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- An OpenAI launch post or livestream could come at any time after the 2026-09-01 "soon" statement.
- **Key distinction:** a Daybreak-only first release (organisations only) would not count. Access through ChatGPT paid plans or open self-serve API access would count.
- Watch for:
  - an API model identifier appearing in OpenAI's docs or pricing page;
  - ChatGPT release notes;
  - AWS Bedrock listings;
  - further safety or government statements that could add delay.

Sources: links inline above.
